title: Physical macOS Audio Settings permission and list states

cases.reason: Sanitized controller timeline observed initializing -> ready. The actual pending frame was too brief to capture visually; controller evidence alone does not complete this criterion.

cases.criterion: Actual OS microphone permission denied and manual refresh without prompt loop
cases.reason: Read-only System Settings microphone panel had an empty app list. Native capture/check succeeded without a permission prompt. No actual OS denial was induced or observed.

cases.criterion: Actual system-restricted microphone state and separate instruction
cases.reason: No restricted policy was available on this host; no TCC or managed policy was modified.

cases.criterion: Actual bootstrap failure or device-enumeration failure distinct from denial
cases.reason: Physical native initialization and enumeration succeeded. No real failure was observed; controller tests are supporting evidence only.

cases.criterion: Actual successful empty inventory and successful nonempty inventory
cases.reason: Nonempty inventory passed in both modes; real empty native inventory could not be produced with builtin endpoints.

successful_nonempty_inventory.interpretation: Each list contains system-default alias plus the one concrete builtin endpoint; these are not two physical devices.

cases.criterion: OS permission grant then refresh without app restart in Debug and Release
cases.reason: No OS permission-denied state or grant prompt occurred; no recovery-from-denial claim is made.

cases.criterion: Dropdown, device selection, local mic check and Join remain functional without duplicate error
cases.reason: Both modes displayed real dropdowns and success notice, persisted selection, started/stopped local microphone check and connected to real local voice room. No duplicate error notice observed.
